daily_load_assessment: Today's readiness is high from a fatigue standpoint (CTL 16.2, ATL 6.6, TSB +9.6). However, you have had zero logged training stimulus over the last 7 days since October 20th. Your resting HR is steady at 48 bpm and HRV is 43 ms. With acute fatigue neutralized, your body is fully rested and primed for work, but returning after 7 inactive days requires sharp execution rather than massive volume overkill.
acute_status_assessment_3_weeks: Over the last 21 days, you have completed only 5 light sessions totaling 2.68 hours and 151 training load units. Acute Training Load (ATL) has dropped significantly to 6.6. This is a severe under-stimulation phase that has caused your short-term fitness to stall well below your target CTL of 60. Rebuilding training consistency is paramount starting today.
sport_trend_assessment_6_months: Your long-term CTL sits at 16.2, leaving a massive gap to reach your target CTL of 60. Over the past 6 months, training load has fluctuated with sporadic high-load spike days followed by long multi-day lulls. To reach CTL 60 safely at +1 to +2 CTL/week without injury, you need structured consistency, leveraging your e-bike base and adhering to a strict 70/30 pyramidal distribution.
coach_verdict: Your freshness metrics are clean, but 7 days of complete rest means we must re-engage your metabolic system immediately. Priority 1 is a targeted Cycling VO2max interval workout to directly attack your 5-minute power goal while your legs are fresh. If weather or scheduling dictates running, Priority 2 delivers a high-quality 5k interval run. Priority 3 is a heavy strength session to build cycling torque.

priority_1.workout_details: 15 min Zone 2 warm-up with 3x15s cadence surges. Main Set: 5 x 3 minutes @ 275-295W (Zone 5, high cadence ~95-100 rpm), with 3 minutes Zone 1 recovery between reps. 15 min Zone 2 cool-down. Total duration: ~55 mins.
priority_1.reason: Highest priority because your freshness (TSB +9.6) provides the perfect neural state to hit high-power targets without cardiovascular drag. Directly addresses your key goal of improving 5-minute cycling power.

priority_2.workout_details: 10 min easy Zone 2 run + dynamic strides. Main Set: 5 x 800m @ target 5km pace (HR Zone 4/5, ~175-185 bpm) with 90 seconds walking/jogging recovery. 10 min easy cool-down. Total volume: ~6.5 km.
priority_2.reason: Top running option to target your 5km performance metric. Excellent workout after a 7-day break to re-establish running economy and high-end aerobic capacity without excessive leg destruction.

priority_3.session_title: Heavy Lower Body Torque & Upper Body Aesthetics
priority_3.workout_details: 1. Barbell Back Squats: 4 x 5 reps @ 80% 1RM. 2. Romanian Deadlifts: 3 x 8 reps. 3. Overhead Barbell Press superset with Pull-ups: 3 x 6-8 reps. 4. Sandbag/Kettlebell Core Carries & Bicep Curls: 3 sets to cap session.
priority_3.reason: Solid alternative if endurance training is not possible today. Builds muscle-tendon stiffness, core stability, and max torque capacity for cycling power, taking full advantage of your rested muscular state.
